translation: Now, what is hidden yet becomes manifest is the accumulation (積). Within the skin and membranes of the human body there must be fluids (津液) moistening the spaces between, for these are what qi and blood generate. When qi and blood stagnate because of injury from external influences, then the fluids change into saliva and froth and congeal. Qi and blood can be restored to flow, but the congealed matter cannot be dissolved again; it secretly breeds and grows in darkness, never decreasing but only increasing. This is how accumulation comes to be formed.
